name: difficulty-ladder-v1
rationale: Three django tasks of INCREASING localization difficulty, chosen so the indexing feature's benefit should grow monotonically down the ladder. All are django v3.1, so they REUSE the already-built swebench env image (sweb.env.py.arm64.a18371b03f...) and the cached repo_cache/django__django clone — minimal network, which matters on a slow connection. Difficulty is judged by how findable the target file is FROM THE ISSUE TEXT (the axis a semantic index improves), not just fix size. Labels confirmed against the dataset (fix lines, FAIL_TO_PASS/PASS_TO_PASS, issue length). See https://huggingface.co/datasets/princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Lite/viewer/default/test

buckets.easy: Issue names a shallow, well-known area; target file directly implied. Baseline should plausibly resolve. Index gives marginal search-turn savings.
buckets.medium: Symptom is one non-obvious hop from the fix; agent must trace it into an internal (but known) ORM file. Index should cut the tracing round-trips.
buckets.hard: Long/vague issue, fix buried deep in a huge central file. Index should help most — fewer search turns and possibly a resolution flip.

note_on_12113: django-12113 (our first graded task) LOOKED localized (10-line fix) but baseline still FAILED it by editing a test file (tests/test_sqlite.py) instead of the gold sqlite3/creation.py. Its target is obscure test-DB plumbing. django-12308 replaces it as the 'easy' rung because its issue->file mapping is far more direct.

tasks.why: Readonly JSONField shows as dict in admin. Named, shallow area -> admin/utils.py display_for_field is easy to localize.
Inherited model won't order by Parent.Meta '-pk'. Must trace an ordering symptom into the SQL compiler -- one non-obvious hop.
GROUP BY error with tricky M2M-through annotation. Long vague issue; fix buried in query.py (Django's biggest ORM file), high regression blast radius.
